# TODO: Convert from M3QL

fetch component:versionfx
    package:cadence-server-oss
    # only cadence-server expected to work, but we may change that in the future
    service:cadence-{workers,frontend,history,matching,server}

spec.description:
The go.mod version of all our server instances.

Counts number of service-deployments using a version, so e.g. frontend prod-phx2 counts as +1, history prod-phx2 counts as +1, and all four services at the same version in a phx/dca paired cluster is +8, but it does not show number of instances (no host tags).
spec.title: vServer (all)

spec.expr:
# TODO: Convert from M3QL
# fetch component:versionfx
    package:cadence-client
    deployment:$deployment
    | max version service
    | removeEmpty
    | isNonNull
    | moving 1h max
    | sum version
    | sort current desc
    | aliasByTags version

spec.description:
Client library versions that cadence's services are using.

Client and server can change separately, but generally both should be "near newest" and may often change in the same deploy.
spec.title: vClient (cadence-client)

spec.expr:
# TODO: Convert from M3QL
# fetch component:versionfx
    package:cadence-server-oss
    # only cadence-server expected to work, but we may change that in the future
    service:cadence-{workers,frontend,history,matching,server}
    deployment:$deployment
    | max version service
    | removeEmpty
    | isNonNull
    | moving 1h max
    | sum version
    | sort current desc
    | aliasByTags version
